events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Thompson (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Sheppard (HOU) initiates contact with Mitchell's (MIA) wrist during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Smith Jr. (HOU) is moving alongside Herro's (MIA) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Smith Jr. (HOU) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Sengun (HOU) establishes, and maintains, a legal guarding position as he defends Adebayo's (MIA) shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) establishes himself in Mitchell's (MIA) path prior to the contact.
Sheppard (HOU) legally contests Fontecchio's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) establishes himself in Larsson's (MIA) path prior to the contact.
Adebayo (MIA) extends his leg toward the ball when contact occurs with Thompson's (HOU) wrist, causing him to lose control of the ball.
Mitchell (MIA) makes incidental contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm after Thompson (HOU) has lost control of the ball.
Thompson (HOU) steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to Heat (MIA).
Smith Jr. (HOU) is moving alongside Larsson's (MIA) path as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Fontecchio (MIA) reaches for the ball when marginal contact occurs with Durant (HOU) before he continues to dribble.
Sengun (HOU) fails to fully clear and is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Sheppard's (HOU) shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) extends his hands forward into Adebayo's (MIA) upper body to commit the take foul.
Larsson (MIA) dislodges the pass out of bounds, and possession correctly remains with HOU.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it was confirmed that Smith Jr. (HOU) blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Adebayo (MIA) removes his resting hand from Durant (HOU) as Durant enters his upward shooting motion. Adebayo then legally contests the jump shot attempt.
Ware (MIA) makes incidental contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm after Thompson's (HOU) shot attempt near the rim.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it was confirmed that Thompson's (HOU) shot was released prior to the expiration of the game clock.
